task: 2KI18-25 map review repair: Israel polity vs people
rationaleJa: 固定WEB本文のIsrael用例を全件再確認し、king of Israel / kings of Israel / removed Israel の王国・政治的用法には既存place:northern-kingdom-of-israel_1302、children/tribes/judges/made Israel sin等の人々・集団用法には既存person:israel_682を使う。God of Israelは称号句で政治領域を示さないためplace IDを付けない。新IDは作成していない。

changedRows.sourceText: Now in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
adopted: 18:1の「king of Israel」はホセアが統治する北王国を明示する。これはイスラエルの祖先個人ではなく政治体。

changedRows.sourceText: In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria and besieged it.
adopted: 18:9の「king of Israel」は北王国の王号を示す。

changedRows.sourceText: At the end of three years they took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
adopted: 18:10の「king of Israel」はホセアの統治年を示す北王国の王号。

changedRows.sourceText: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.
adopted: 21:3の「Ahab king of Israel」はアハブの王国・政治的称号を明示する。

changedRows.sourceText: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.
adopted: 23:13の「Solomon king of Israel」はソロモンの王国・政治的称号を明示する。

changedRows.sourceText: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.
adopted: 23:15の「made Israel to sin」は民を罪に導いたという集合的な人々への言及で、北王国という政治体とは区別する。

changedRows.sourceText: All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.
adopted: 23:19の「kings of Israel」は高き所を建てた歴代王の政治体を指す。

changedRows.sourceText: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
adopted: 「Israel」を裁きを受ける民として明記する。 祖先個人や土地とは区別する。
23:22の「kings of Israel」は北王国の歴代王を指す政治的用法。

changedRows.sourceText: The LORD said, “I will also remove Judah out of my sight, as I have removed Israel; and I will cast off this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’”
adopted: 23:27の「removed Israel」は王国が主の前から除かれたという政治体の比較として読む。人々の個人IDではない。

changedRows.sourceText: He carried out from there all the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the LORD’s temple, as the LORD had said.
adopted: 24:13の「Solomon king of Israel」はソロモンの王国・政治的称号を明示する。
